features.feature: M0: machine-validated protocol.json with sha256 protocolHash written by freeze, verified by validate (validate exits non-zero on any missing/malformed field or hash mismatch)
M0: memory-snapshot hash frozen — memorySnapshotHash field in protocol.json, written alongside memory-snapshot-hash.json
M0: hash stability — canonical JSON serialization (stable key order, createdAt/timestamps outside hashed payload, protocolHash field excluded)

M2: pair-ledger.jsonl (one row per fixture pair: pairId, control|treatment arm slots, status pending)
M2: run-order-seed.json with deterministic seeded run order (xmur3+mulberry32+Fisher-Yates); same seed + same manifest -> byte-identical runOrder
M2: ledger immutability — build and all mutating operations refuse when score-records.jsonl exists in the experiment root

M5: twoProportionNPerArm — pooled two-sided z-test approximation (reduction direction: treatment = baseline MINUS mde)
M5: mcnemarDiscordantPairs — McNemar discordant-pair sizing for the paired design
M5: wilson95 CI helper returning {lower, upper, width}
M5: pilotFreezeCheck implementing the S7 freeze rule (>=15 control-arm fault runs required; freeze N at Wilson 95% lower bound; extend flag if width > 0.30)
M5: adequacy report (adequacy-report.json + adequacy-report.md) showing per population planned N per arm, assumptions, detectable effect, in-band maximum

M5: S7 anchor values asserted in selfcheck — nPerArm(0.30,0.10)=294; nPerArm(0.625,0.25)=62; nPerArm(0.5,0.35)=27; nPerArm(0.5,0.25)=58; in-band max=62 near 0.625/0.25; Wilson freeze rule and direction trap
M5: per-population parameters separately declared (seeded: alpha 0.05, power 0.80, baselineBand [0.5,0.8], mdeBand [0.25,0.35]; live: alpha 0.05, power 0.80, baseline 0.30, mde 0.10)
